title: Generation of inflammation-responsive astrocytes from glial progenitors derived from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Thaw iPSC lines on dry ice and transfer vials to a 37°C water bath.
Remove vials from the water bath when approximately half of the content remains frozen.
Gently add 500 μL of warm DMEM/F-12 using a pipette, mix by pipetting up and down until completely thawed.
Transfer cells to a centrifuge tube containing 12 mL DMEM/F-12 medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Gently aspirate the supernatant leaving about 100 μL of media in the bottom of the tube, gently flick with finger to resuspend cell pellet.
Aspirate Matrigel solution from 6-well plates.
Transfer cells to pre-coated Matrigel plates without washing before plating.
Gently add 2 mL of mTeSR1 ROCK inhibitor medium to resuspended cells.
Transfer the entire volume to one well of a 6-well plate.
Place the plate in the incubator.
Shake the plate side to side and back and forth for homogeneous distribution of the cells.
Replace media with 2 mL of fresh mTeSR1 the next day to remove ROCK inhibitor Y-27632.
Prepare collagenase IV medium by adding 1 mg/mL collagenase IV to DMEM/F-12 at a 1:10 dilution of stock solution.
Mark differentiated cells for removal using a microscope on the plate.
Wash once with 3 mL warm PBS.
Add 1 mL of collagenase IV medium per well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator for 15 minutes.
Wash twice with 3 mL of warm DMEM/F-12 medium.
Remove differentiated cells using a plastic tip.
Wash once with 3 mL of warm DMEM/F-12 medium.
Add 1 mL mTeSR1 medium per well and gently scrape the cells using a cell lifter to detach them from the plate.
Resuspend detached cells in sufficient mTeSR1 medium (2 mL/well) for replating at a 1:4–6 ratio on 6-well Matrigel-coated plates.
Place the plate in the incubator and gently shake it side to side and back and forth for homogeneous distribution of the cells.
Grow iPSCs in mTeSR1 medium on 3 wells of 6-well Matrigel-coated plates until 80% confluent.
Warm DMEM/F-12 for wash.
Prepare collagenase IV medium by adding 1 mg/mL collagenase IV to DMEM/F12 (1:10 dilution of stock solution); 1 mL/well of a 6-well plate is needed.
Mark on the plate differentiated cells for removal using a microscope.
Wash 1× with warm PBS.
Add 1 mL of collagenase IV medium and incubate 15 min in the 37°C incubator; at this point, the edges of the colonies start curling up and are ready to be detached.
Wash 2× with 3 mL of warm DMEM/F-12 medium.
Remove differentiated cells with a plastic tip.
Wash 1× with 3 mL of warm DMEM/F-12 medium.
Add 1 mL mTeSR1 medium/well, scrape the cells using a cell lifter.
Resuspend aggregates of cells from the 3 wells in 9 mL mTeSR1 ROCK inhibitor medium (equivalent to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL).
Transfer to 3 wells of a low attachment 6-well plate.
Incubate with gentle shaking (90 rpm) in the 37°C incubator.
Transfer media carefully to 15 mL conical tubes on Day 1.
Centrifuge the conical tubes at 200 xg for 1-2 minutes at room temperature.
Gently aspirate supernatant, leaving approximately 200 μL of media in each tube.
Resuspend cell pellet by gently flicking with finger and adding 3 mL ScienCell Astrocyte Media (AM medium) supplemented with Noggin and PDGF-AA.
Pipette up and down gently to resuspend cells.
Transfer the suspension back to the original well.
Perform a complete media change using 3 mL/well of AM medium on Days 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13.
Change media for EBs by using gravity in inclined plates under the flow hood on days indicated.
Switch to AM medium with PDGF-AA at 10 ng/mL on days 15, 17, and 19.
Keep agitation after switching media.
Centrifuge EBs collected from three wells at 200 g for 1 minute or let them settle in a tube.
Resuspend EBs by flicking and wash once with warm PBS.
Resuspend EBs with ribonuclease/papain solution as per Worthington kit instructions.
Incubate the resuspended EBs in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator for 1 hour, pipetting vigorously every 15 minutes.
Check under microscope to confirm single cell suspension.
Count the cells.
Plate the cells at a density of 200,000–300,000 cells/mL in AM medium supplemented with FGF2, EGF, laminin, and ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 in PLO-laminin coated plates.
Replace the medium with fresh AM supplemented with FGF2 and EGF to remove ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 the next day.
Perform a complete medium change every other day using 2–3 mL/well of expansion medium (AM supplemented with FGF2, EGF, and laminin).
Passage cells when they cover over 80% of the plate using Accutase.
Prepare centrifuge tubes containing warm DMEM/F-12 for cell wash (1 tube per well of a 6-well plate).
Wash cells once with warm PBS.
Add 1 mL of warm Accutase per well and incubate in the 37°C incubator for 5–10 minutes.
Collect the cells by pipetting up and down and transfer to a centrifuge tube containing DMEM/F-12 medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g, 5 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the cells in sufficient expansion medium to replate them at a 1:6–8 ratio (10,000–20,000 cells/cm²) on PLO-laminin coated plates.
Dissociate cells with Accutase as for passaging.
Centrifuge the cell suspension after dissociation.
Remove supernatant from the cell pellet.
Add AM medium containing 10% DMSO drop by drop to the cell pellet (1 mL per well of a 6-well plate will result in 1 × 10^6 cells per vial).
Transfer the cell suspension to a cryovial.
Freeze the cryovial at -80°C for 12–24 h, then store in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw GPCs quickly in a water bath at 37°C.
Transfer thawed cells into a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing warm DMEM/F-12 (12 mL) and spin down at 200 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Gently aspirate the supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL of media in the bottom of the tube to resuspend cell pellet.
Add 12 mL of expansion medium (AM supplemented with FGF2 20 ng/mL, EGF 20 ng/mL, laminin 1 μg/mL).
Plate on 2 mL/well in a 6-well PLO-laminin coated plate.
Wash DMSO present in storage media completely to remove toxicity.
Plate GPCs at 15,000 cells/cm² in expansion medium (AM supplemented with FGF2 20 ng/mL, EGF 20 ng/mL, laminin 1 μg/mL) on day 1 for differentiation into astrocytes.
Change the expansion AM medium to DMEM/F-12 Glutamax supplemented with N-2, B-27 and 10% FBS (induction media) on day 2.
Change media completely every other day from day 3 to day 14.
Split cells to non-coated plates using Accutase on day 15.
Prepare 15 mL centrifuge tubes containing warm 12 mL DMEM/F-12 for cell wash.
Warm Accutase solution or Accumax.
Wash once with warm PBS.
Add 1 mL of warm Accutase (or Accumax) and incubate 5–10 min in the 37°C incubator.
Collect cells by gently pipetting up and down and transfer to a centrifuge tube containing 12 mL DMEM/F-12 medium for washing.
Centrifuge at 200 xg, 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in sufficient induction medium for replating at a 1:6 ratio (20,000–25,000 cells/cm²) on 6-well non-coated plates.
Perform a complete medium change every other day using 2-3 mL/well of induction medium after day 15.
Replace Accutase with Accumax if astrocytes become sticky and difficult to dissociate.
Reduce the FBS concentration to 5% or 2% after splitting at day 15 to slow proliferation without affecting maturation.
Use ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 at 10 μM for improving viability during splitting at day 15 (optional).
Store astrocytes frozen in induction medium plus 10% DMSO from day 7 up to 4 weeks post differentiation.
